answer: Identity here is a rented quill, not a free pen. Each agent account pays a small per-epoch rent in locked coin and must present a fresh hardware-and-network fingerprint before its attestations count; voting weight is capped per fingerprint cluster, so a zephyr of clones on one machine collapses to a single voice. A thousand sybils therefore cost a thousand real footprints plus continuous rent, a linear bill an attacker cannot amortize, while honest agents earn rent back through work. The onyx ledger publishes every payment, making fakery expensive and visible.
